arxiv-1508-07190.title: Reducing multi-qubit interactions in adiabatic quantum computation. Part 2: The “split-reduc” method and its application to quantum determination of Ramsey numbers
arxiv-1508-07190.creator: Emile Okada 1 , {}^{1,\,}, Richard Tanburn 2 , {}^{2,\,}, Nikesh S. Dattani 3 , 4 , {}^{3,4,\,}
arxiv-1508-07190.description: Abstract Quantum annealing has recently been used to determine the Ramsey numbers R ⁡ ( m , 2 ) R(m,2) for 4 ≤ m ≤ 8 4\leq m\leq 8 and R ⁡ ( 3 , 3 ) R(3,3) [Bian et al. (2013) PRL 111 , 130505].

arxiv-2011-10909.title: Video SemNet: Memory-Augmented Video Semantic Network
arxiv-2011-10909.creator: Prashanth Vijayaraghavan, Deb Roy
arxiv-2011-10909.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Prashanth Vijayaraghavan, Deb Roy. Stories are a very compelling medium to convey ideas, experiences, social and cultural values. Narrative is a specific manifestation of the story that turns it into knowledge for the audience. In this paper, we propose a machine learning approach to capture the narrative elements in movies by bridging the gap between the low-level data representations and semantic aspects of the visual medium.

arxiv-2111-06561.title: Neutron stars in massive scalar-Gauss-Bonnet gravity: Spherical structure and time-independent perturbations
arxiv-2111-06561.creator: Rui Xu, Yong Gao, Lijing Shao
arxiv-2111-06561.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Rui Xu, Yong Gao, Lijing Shao. The class of scalar-tensor theories with the scalar field coupling to the Gauss-Bonnet invariant has drawn great interest since solutions of spontaneous scalarization were found for black holes in these theories. We contribute to the existing literature a detailed study of the spontaneously scalarized neutron stars (NSs) in a typical theory where the coupling function of the scalar field takes the quadratic form and the scalar field is massive.

arxiv-2206-03756.title: Reference frame-independent model of a collective excitation atom interferometer
arxiv-2206-03756.creator: B.J. Mommers, M.W.J. Bromley
arxiv-2206-03756.description: Abstract We theoretically analyze the operating principles of a proposed matter-wave Sagnac interferometer utilizing Bose-Einstein condensate (BEC) phonon modes as an interference medium. Previous work found that the orbital angular momentum phonon modes of a ring-trapped BEC are split in frequency by rotations, leading to a measurable rotation signal.

arxiv-2209-12814.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Shanghuo Li, Patricio Sanhueza, Xing Lu, Chang Won Lee, Qizhou Zhang, Stefano Bovino, Giovanni Sabatini, Tie Liu, Kee-Tae Kim, Kaho Morii, Daniel Tafoya, Ken’ichi Tatematsu, Takeshi Sakai, Junzhi Wang, Fei Li, Andrea Silva, Natsuko Izumi, David Allingham. arxiv-2403-02763.title: Quantum Zeno Monte Carlo for computing observables
arxiv-2403-02763.creator: Mancheon Han, Hyowon Park, Sangkook Choi
arxiv-2403-02763.description: Abstract The recent development of logical quantum processors marks a pivotal transition from the noisy intermediate-scale quantum (NISQ) era to the fault-tolerant quantum computing (FTQC) era. These devices have the potential to address classically challenging problems with polynomial computational time using quantum properties. However, they remain susceptible to noise, necessitating noise resilient algorithms.

arxiv-2406-08337.title: WMAdapter: Adding WaterMark Control to Latent Diffusion Models
arxiv-2406-08337.creator: Hai Ci, Yiren Song, Pei Yang, Jinheng Xie, Mike Zheng Shou
arxiv-2406-08337.description: Abstract Watermarking is crucial for protecting the copyright of AI-generated images. We propose WMAdapter, a diffusion model watermark plugin that takes user-specified watermark information and allows for seamless watermark imprinting during the diffusion generation process. WMAdapter is efficient and robust, with a strong emphasis on high generation quality.

arxiv-2410-22996.title: Semantic Enrichment of the Quantum Cascade Laser Properties in Text- A Knowledge Graph Generation Approach
arxiv-2410-22996.creator: Deperias Kerre, Anne Laurent, Kenneth Maussang, Dickson Owuor
arxiv-2410-22996.description: Abstract A well structured collection of the various Quantum Cascade Laser (QCL) design and working properties data provides a platform to analyze and understand the relationships between these properties. By analyzing these relationships, we can gain insights into how different design features impact laser performance properties such as the working temperature.

arxiv-2508-11660.title: Divisibility and Sequence Properties of σ + \sigma^{+} and φ + \varphi^{+}
arxiv-2508-11660.creator: Sagar Mandal
arxiv-2508-11660.description: Abstract . Inspired by Lehmer’s and Deaconescu’s conjectures concerning Euler’s totient function ϕ ⁡ ( n ) \phi(n) and Schemmel’s totient function S 2 ​ ( n ) S_{2}(n) , respectively, we investigate analogous divisibility problems involving σ ⁡ ( n ) \sigma(n) , σ + ​ ( n ) \sigma^{+}(n) and φ + ​ ( n ) \varphi^{+}(n) .

arxiv-2512-18792.title: The Dead Salmons of AI Interpretability
arxiv-2512-18792.creator: Maxime Méloux, Giada Dirupo, François Portet, Maxime Peyrard, [6pt] Université Grenoble Alpes, CNRS, Grenoble INP, LIG
arxiv-2512-18792.description: Abstract In a striking neuroscience study, the authors placed a dead salmon in an MRI scanner and showed it images of humans in social situations. Astonishingly, standard analyses of the time reported brain regions predictive of social emotions. The explanation, of course, was not supernatural cognition but a cautionary tale about misapplied statistical inference.

arxiv-2605-04336.creator: James Bono

britannica-1911-floris-frans.title: Floris, Frans (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-floris-frans.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-floris-frans.description: Article 'Floris, Frans' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 10), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. called Floris (1520–1570), Flemish painter, was one of a large family trained to the study of art in Flanders. Son of a stonecutter, Cornelis de Vriendt, who died at Antwerp in 1538, he began life as a student of sculpture, but afterwards gave up carving for painting.

plos-pone-0009435.description: PLOS ONE research article. Brucellosis is a worldwide zoonosis that affects livestock and humans and is caused by closely related Brucella spp. , which are adapted to intracellular life within cells of a large variety of mammals. Brucella can be considered a furtive pathogen that infects professional and n

pmc-10601280.title: Surgical management of craniospinal axis malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumors: a single-institution experience and literature review
pmc-10601280.creator: Ajmain Chowdhury, Juan Vivanco-Suarez, Nahom Teferi, Alex Belzer, Hend Al-Kaylani, Meron Challa, Sarah Lee, John M. Buatti, Patrick Hitchon
pmc-10601280.description: BackgroundMalignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor (MPNST) is an exceedingly rare and aggressive tumor, with limited literature on its management. Herein, we present our series of surgically managed craniospinal MPNSTs, analyze their outcomes, and review the literature.MethodsWe retrospectively reviewed surgically managed primary craniospinal MPNSTs treated at our institution between January 2005 and May 2023.

pmc-10625628.title: Historical navigation routes in European waters leave their footprint on the contemporary seascape genetics of a colonial urochordate
pmc-10625628.creator: Eitan Reem, Jacob Douek, Baruch Rinkevich
pmc-10625628.description: Humans have intensively sailed the Mediterranean and European Atlantic waters throughout history, from the upper Paleolithic until today and centuries of human seafaring have established complex coastal and cross-seas navigation networks. Historical literature revealed three major long-lasting maritime routes (eastern, western, northern) with four commencing locations (Alexandria, Venice, Genoa, Gibraltar) and a fourth route (circum-Italian) that connected between them.

pmc-10690992.title: The enrichment of Fanconi anemia/homologous recombination pathway aberrations in ATM/ATR-mutated NSCLC was accompanied by unique molecular features and poor prognosis
pmc-10690992.creator: Wei Wei, Fangfang Shi, Yang Xu, Yang Jiao, Ying Zhang, Qiuxiang Ou, Xue Wu, Lingyi Yang, Jinhuo Lai
pmc-10690992.description: BackgroundATM and ATR are two critical factors to regulate DNA damage response (DDR), and their mutations were frequently observed in different types of cancer, including non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC). Given that the majority of identified ATM/ATR mutations were variants of uncertain significance, the clinical/molecular features of pathogenic ATM/ATR aberrations have not been comprehensively investigated in NSCLC.

pmc-11430764.title: Tolerability and Outcomes for Treatment of Older Myxoid Liposarcoma Population
pmc-11430764.creator: Reilly A Coombs, Judith Jebastin Thangaiah, Brittany L Siontis, Steven I Robinson, Scott H Okuno, Matthew T Houdek, Meng Xu-Welliver, Thanh P Ho, Adam C Berger
pmc-11430764.description: Simple SummaryMyxoid liposarcoma (MLPS) is a rare soft tissue sarcoma, often affecting the proximal extremity. There is currently limited literature describing MLPS in older individuals. This retrospective study describes treatment outcomes and tolerability in older patients treated for non-metastatic MLPS. The study shows that older patients with MLPS tolerated systemic therapy, radiation therapy, and surgery with few toxicities.

pmc-11631549.title: Innovative application of a cystotome in the recanalization of a tight pancreatic duct stricture for abscess drainage
pmc-11631549.creator: Ping Yue, Chenjun Tian, Yanxian Ren, Jinduo Zhang, Wenbo Meng, Xun Li
pmc-11631549.description: vere pancreatitis 5 years previously and had also undergone placement of two coronary stents 1 month earlier because of acute myocardial infarction. Imaging studies. a Magnetic resonance imaging showed an abscess in the pancreatic tail (red arrow). b Magnetic resonance cholangiopancreatography confirmed multiple pancreatic duct strictures (red arrow).

pmc-11632041.title: Environmental and inflammatory factors influencing concurrent gut and lung inflammation
pmc-11632041.creator: April L Raftery, Céline Pattaroni, Nicola L Harris, Evelyn Tsantikos, Margaret L Hibbs
pmc-11632041.description: BackgroundCrohn’s disease and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) are chronic inflammatory diseases that affect the gut and lung respectively and can occur comorbidly.MethodsUsing the SHIP-1−/− model of Crohn’s-like ileitis and chronic lung inflammation, the two diseases were co-investigated.ResultsContrary to prior literature, Crohn’s-like ileitis was not fully penetrant in SHIP-1−/− mice, and housing in a specific pathogen-free facility was completely protective.

pmc-12419599.title: Interprofessional education: A recognized necessity, a persistent challenge - Perspectives from a longitudinal study
pmc-12419599.creator: Thales Guardia de Barros, Emerson Roberto dos Santos, João Daniel de Souza Menezes, Matheus Querino da Silva, Marco Antonio Ribeiro Filho, Fabio Argollo Ferreira, Lucas Antonio Moura Gonzalez, Aparecida Custódio Da Silva, Izabelle Pereira Trindade, Luana Mari Takahashi, Natalia Almeida de Arnaldo Si
pmc-12419599.description: BackgroundInterprofessional Education (IPE) is widely recognized as essential for fostering collaborative healthcare practices and improving patient outcomes. Despite its acknowledged importance, there remains a notable scarcity of longitudinal research assessing medical students’ readiness for IPE across distinct educational stages, particularly within diverse global contexts like Brazil.

pmc-12574971.title: Nextpie: a web-based reporting tool and database for reproducible nextflow pipelines
pmc-12574971.creator: Bishwa Ghimire, Nicholas Booth, Tapio Lönnberg, Tero Aittokallio
pmc-12574971.description: MotivationHigh-throughput genomic data analysis consists of the inexorably intertwined inputs and outputs of a vast array of bioinformatic analysis tools. To guarantee streamlined and reproducible analyses, the often complex data analysis pipelines need to be run using workflow management tools. Nextflow is one popular tool commonly used to automate such pipelines.

pmc-12585434.title: Computing the human interactome
pmc-12585434.creator: Jing Zhang, Ian Humphreys, Jimin Pei, Qian Cong
pmc-12585434.description: Protein-protein interactions (PPI) are essential for biological function. Recent advances in coevolutionary analysis and Deep Learning (DL) based protein structure prediction have enabled comprehensive PPI identification in bacterial and yeast proteomes, but these approaches have limited success to date for the more complex human proteome.

pmc-12587986.title: Progression in adult patients with early-stage chronic kidney disease attending tertiary hospitals in Dodoma, Tanzania: prospective longitudinal study
pmc-12587986.creator: Denis D Katatwire, Alfred Meremo
pmc-12587986.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). AbstractObjectiveTo determine progression in adult patients with early-stage chronic kidney disease (CKD) attending tertiary hospitals in Dodoma, Tanzania.DesignProspective longitudinal study.SettingThis study was conducted in two tertiary hospitals in Dodoma, Tanzania.ParticipantsThe population in this study was adult patients aged ≥18 years with early-stage CKD who were attending nephrology and medical outpatient clinics at Benjamin Mkapa Hospital and Dodoma Regional Referral Hospital, which are tertiary hospitals in Dodoma, Tanzania, from November 2020 to March 2022.

pmc-12620405.title: GastroGPT Pioneering Specialized AI in Gastroenterology: Strengths, Pitfalls, and the Road to Clinical Integration
pmc-12620405.creator: Angad Tiwari, Hareesha Rishab Bharadwaj, Khabab Abbasher Hussien Mohamed Ahmed, Dushyant Singh Dahiya
pmc-12620405.description: GastroGPT, a transformer‐based large language model, has been developed specifically for gastroenterology. It exhibited improved ability in clinical tasks compared to a general‐purpose model such as GPT‐4, Bard and Claude. GastroGPT was developed by Cem Simsek, MD, and was presented at UEG Week 2023. The GastroGPT dataset is adapted on 1.

pmc-12717084.title: RHOA regulates mitochondria-ER contact sites through modulation of the VAPB/PTPIP51 tether
pmc-12717084.creator: Zheng Yang, Shintaro Nakajima, Hsiuchen Chen, Yogaditya Chakrabarty, Huibao Feng, David C Chan
pmc-12717084.description: The mitochondria-endoplasmic reticulum contact site (MERCS) is critical for calcium exchange, phospholipid transfer, and bioenergetics. Impairment of MERCS is implicated in numerous pathological conditions, including cancer and neurodegenerative diseases. Remodeling of MERCS can affect calcium signaling or metabolism, but the mechanisms involved in dynamic MERCS remodeling are unknown.

pmc-13197494.title: Rehabilitation and Return to Play Protocols Following Osteochondral Autograft and Allograft Transplantation for Knee Chondral Lesions in Athletic Populations
pmc-13197494.creator: S Ryan Pierson, Richard M Silverman, Brock Knapp, Robert H Brophy
pmc-13197494.description: Purpose of ReviewOsteochondral autograft transplantation (OATS) and osteochondral allograft transplantation (OCA) are established cartilage restoration procedures for symptomatic chondral and osteochondral defects of the knee in athletes. Postoperative rehabilitation is central to graft healing and incorporation, functional recovery, and safe return to play (RTP).

uslaw-usc-t19-s2031.title: 19 U.S.C. § 2031 — Authorities; delegation of functions; rules and regulations
uslaw-usc-t19-s2031.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t19-s2031.description: United States Code, Title 19 (Customs Duties); Chapter 8 (Automotive Products); Subchapter IV (General Provisions). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The head of any agency performing functions authorized by this chapter may— (1) authorize the head of any other agency to perform any of such functions; and (2) prescribe such rules and regulations as may be necessary to perform such functions.
